text: Assess the reasons for the decline of religious observance in some societies.
‘The legacy of colonialism is alive today in many forms.’ Discuss. [30]
To what extent is continued global population growth sustainable and desirable? [30]
‘Beautiful spaces enhance personal well-being.’ Examine whether such spaces are valued and
maintained in your country. [30]
Scientists can now successfully edit genes in human embryos. Assess the advantages and
disadvantages of this. [30]
Discuss whether an individual’s online activity should be monitored in the fight against crime and
terrorism.
Examine how important it is that the production of traditional crafts continues in your country.
‘Fascination with the sea is common among writers, composers and artists.’ With reference to any
forms of artistic expression, suggest why the sea might provide inspiration.
‘Television advertising rarely tells the truth.’ To what extent do you agree? [30]
Identify the unique characteristics of a city in your country and explain the extent to which these
characteristics are significant. [30]
